posts.title: on finding love
posts.description: I don’t like the usual discourse about dating and how you’re meant to optimize for it. So here are some thoughts on what love actually is and how you find it.

posts.title: on doing things
posts.description: It’s easy to get anxious just from scrolling. Too much noise, too many people doing things, showing progress, achievements. It gives the illusion that everyone’s moving fast while you’re just there, watching.

posts.title: subscription culture sucks
posts.description: When did comfort start coming with a renewal date? Everything you touch wants a subscription, even your bed..
